plan.title: Alan Turing: The Man Who Imagined Thinking Machines
plan.description: A quick look at Alan Turing, the British mathematician who helped break wartime codes and laid the groundwork for modern computers. Learn why his ideas still shape the device in your hand.

beats.narration: He helped end a world war with mathematics, then imagined the computer in your pocket. Meet Alan Turing.
During the Second World War, Turing worked on breaking secret enemy codes in Britain, using logic and machines to read messages once thought unreadable.
He also asked a bold question: can machines think? His ideas became the foundation of computer science and artificial intelligence.
Every time you use a computer, you use his legacy. One curious mind changed how the world works.
